items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which letter comes right after B in the alphabet?
items.explain: The alphabet goes A, B, C, so C comes right after B.

concept.en: knowing the order of the alphabet
concept.es: conocer el orden del abecedario

tip.en: Sing the alphabet song together, then pause and ask what comes next, using magnetic letters or cards in order.
tip.es: Canten juntos la canción del abecedario, hagan pausas para preguntar qué letra sigue y ordenen letras magnéticas o tarjetas.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to the word 'sun'. Which word starts with the same sound as 'sun'?
items.explain: Sun and sock both begin with the /s/ sound.

concept.es: reconocer sonidos iniciales iguales

tip.en: Play 'I spy' with first sounds: find household objects that start with the same sound as the child's name.
tip.es: Jueguen a 'veo veo' con el primer sonido: busquen objetos de casa que empiecen con el mismo sonido que su nombre.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which word rhymes with 'cat'?
items.explain: Cat and hat share the same ending sound -at.

concept.es: reconocer palabras que riman

tip.en: Read rhyming books aloud and pause before the rhyme so your child can guess it; make silly rhyme chains.
tip.es: Lean libros con rimas en voz alta, pausen antes de la rima para que adivine y inventen cadenas de rimas divertidas.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to the word 'bed'. Which word ends with the same sound as 'bed'?
items.explain: Bed and lid both end with the /d/ sound.

concept.es: reconocer sonidos finales iguales

tip.en: Say two words and ask whether they end the same; sort small toys by their last sound.
tip.es: Digan dos palabras y pregunten si terminan igual; clasifiquen juguetes pequeños según su último sonido.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen to these sounds: /p/ /i/ /g/. Put them together. What word do they make?
items.explain: /p/ + /i/ + /g/ blends to make 'pig'.

concept.es: unir sonidos para formar palabras sencillas

tip.en: Stretch out sounds slowly, like /m/ /a/ /p/, and let your child squeeze them together to say the word.
tip.es: Alarguen los sonidos despacio, como /m/ /a/ /p/, y dejen que el niño los junte para decir la palabra.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Clap the parts of the word 'rabbit': rab-bit. How many claps (syllables) do you hear?
items.explain: Rab-bit has two syllables.

concept.es: contar las sílabas de una palabra

tip.en: Clap, stomp or tap the beats in family names and favorite foods, then count the beats together.
tip.es: Den palmadas o pasos al ritmo de los nombres de la familia y comidas favoritas, y cuenten los golpes juntos.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: When we read a page in an English book, where do we start reading?
options: At the bottom of the page
At the top left of the page
In the middle of the page
items.explain: English is read from the top left, moving left to right.

concept.en: how books and print are read
concept.es: cómo se leen los libros y el texto

tip.en: While reading together, run your finger under the words from left to right and let your child turn the pages.
tip.es: Al leer juntos, pasen el dedo bajo las palabras de izquierda a derecha y dejen que pase las páginas.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Point to the word 'and'. (Show the child the three printed words.)
items.explain: The printed word a-n-d spells 'and'.

concept.es: reconocer palabras de uso frecuente

tip.en: Make flash cards for words like 'and' and 'the' and hunt for them in a favorite storybook.
tip.es: Hagan tarjetas con palabras como 'and' y 'the' y búsquenlas juntos en un cuento favorito.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Listen. 'Ben has a red ball. He gives the ball to his little sister, Joy.' Who gets the ball?
items.explain: Ben gives the ball to Joy, so Joy gets it.

concept.en: understanding a short story heard aloud
concept.es: comprender un cuento corto que se escucha

tip.en: After reading a short story aloud, ask who, what and where questions, and let your child retell it.
tip.es: Después de leer un cuento corto, hagan preguntas de quién, qué y dónde, y pidan que lo cuente con sus palabras.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Say: Which one is a fruit?
items.explain: An apple is a fruit; a chair and a shoe are not food.

concept.es: clasificar palabras por categorías

tip.en: Sort toys, foods or picture cards into groups like fruits, animals and clothes, and name each group.
tip.es: Clasifiquen juguetes, comidas o tarjetas en grupos como frutas, animales y ropa, y pongan nombre a cada grupo.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which letter is missing? d, e, __, g
items.explain: Alphabetical order is d, e, f, g.

concept.en: finding a missing letter in the alphabet
concept.es: encontrar una letra que falta en el abecedario

tip.en: Lay out alphabet cards in a row, hide one, and let your child find which letter is missing.
tip.es: Pongan tarjetas del abecedario en fila, escondan una y pidan al niño que descubra qué letra falta.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Read and understand a simple sentence
items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'Pam has a pet pup.' What does Pam have?
items.explain: The sentence says Pam has a pet pup.

concept.en: reading and understanding a simple sentence
concept.es: leer y comprender una oración sencilla

tip.en: Read short sentences together and ask a simple question about each one, like who or what.
tip.es: Lean oraciones cortas juntos y hagan una pregunta sencilla sobre cada una, como quién o qué.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Distinguish long a from short a
items.prompt: Which word has the long a sound, as in 'cake'?
items.explain: In 'rain' the letters ai make the long a sound; the others have short a.

concept.en: hearing long and short a sounds
concept.es: distinguir el sonido largo y corto de la a

tip.en: Collect word pairs like 'cap' and 'cape' and sort them into short a and long a piles.
tip.es: Reúnan pares de palabras como 'cap' y 'cape' y clasifíquenlas en montones de a corta y a larga.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Find short i in a sentence
items.prompt: Read the sentence: 'Mike will ride his bike to the lake.' Which word has the short i sound?
items.explain: 'Will' has a short i; Mike, ride and bike have a long i.

concept.es: identificar el sonido corto de la i

tip.en: Go on a short i word hunt in a favorite book, listening for words like 'sit' and 'big'.
tip.es: Busquen en un libro favorito palabras con i corta, como 'sit' y 'big', escuchando bien el sonido.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word begins with the 'ch' sound and has a short e sound?
items.explain: 'Chest' begins with ch and has a short e; cheek has long e, shell begins with sh, chain has long a.

concept.en: reading the 'ch' sound with short e
concept.es: leer el sonido 'ch' con e corta

tip.en: Practice words like 'chest' and 'check' with letter tiles, building and reading them aloud.
tip.es: Practiquen palabras como 'chest' y 'check' con fichas de letras, armándolas y leyéndolas en voz alta.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: In which word does the letter c make the /s/ sound?
items.explain: In 'face' the c is followed by e, so it makes the soft /s/ sound.

concept.en: knowing when c sounds like s
concept.es: saber cuándo la c suena como s

tip.en: Notice that c before e, i or y often says /s/; list words like 'city' and 'face'.
tip.es: Noten que la c antes de e, i o y suele sonar /s/; hagan una lista con palabras como 'city' y 'face'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence: Right now, Sam is ___ a picture for Grandma.
items.explain: 'Is' with 'right now' needs the -ing form: is painting.

concept.es: añadir -ing a las palabras de acción

tip.en: Act out actions and say what you are doing, such as 'I am jumping', then write the -ing word.
tip.es: Representen acciones y digan lo que hacen, como 'I am jumping', y luego escriban la palabra con -ing.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: In which word does the letter y make the long i sound?
items.explain: At the end of 'fly', y says long i; in the others y says /y/.

concept.en: hearing y as a long i sound
concept.es: reconocer la y con sonido de i larga

tip.en: Read words like 'my', 'fly' and 'try' aloud and sort them from words where y sounds different.
tip.es: Lean en voz alta palabras como 'my', 'fly' y 'try' y sepárenlas de las que suenan distinto.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'moon'?
items.explain: 'Spoon' has the long oo sound like moon; book has short oo.

concept.es: reconocer el sonido largo de oo

tip.en: Make a list of rhyming 'oo' words like moon, spoon and zoo, and draw a picture for each.
tip.es: Hagan una lista de palabras con oo que riman, como moon, spoon y zoo, y dibujen cada una.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the long o sound, as in 'boat'?
items.explain: In 'road' the oa team makes the long o sound; the others have short o.

concept.es: leer palabras con o larga escrita oa

tip.en: Build words like boat, coat and road with letter tiles and read them aloud together.
tip.es: Formen palabras como boat, coat y road con fichas de letras y léanlas juntos en voz alta.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'book'?
items.explain: 'Wood' and 'book' share the short oo sound.

concept.es: reconocer el sonido corto de oo

tip.en: Compare 'book' and 'moon' aloud, then find other short oo words like 'foot' and 'cook'.
tip.es: Comparen 'book' y 'moon' en voz alta y busquen otras palabras con oo corta como 'foot' y 'cook'.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'cow'?
items.explain: The ou in 'house' sounds like the ow in 'cow'; snow, show and grow have long o.

concept.en: hearing the ou and ow sound
concept.es: reconocer el sonido ou y ow

tip.en: Read words like cow, house and cloud, and see how ow and ou often make the same sound.
tip.es: Lean palabras como cow, house y cloud, y observen que ow y ou suelen sonar igual.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: How many vowels are in the word 'garden'?
items.explain: G-a-r-d-e-n has two vowels: a and e.

concept.es: encontrar las vocales en las palabras

tip.en: Write words on paper and circle the vowels a, e, i, o, u with a colored pencil.
tip.es: Escriban palabras en papel y rodeen las vocales a, e, i, o, u con un lápiz de color.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence needs a question mark at the end?
items.explain: 'Where is my blue coat' asks something, so it needs a question mark.

concept.es: elegir la puntuación final correcta

tip.en: Read sentences aloud with expression and decide together whether each needs a period, question mark or exclamation mark.
tip.es: Lean oraciones en voz alta con expresión y decidan juntos si llevan punto, signo de pregunta o de exclamación.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: The children ___ singing in church last Sunday.
items.explain: 'Children' is plural and the time is past, so 'were' is correct.

concept.es: usar was y were correctamente

tip.en: Say sentences about one person and about many, like 'He was' and 'They were', and practice both.
tip.es: Digan oraciones sobre una persona y sobre varias, como 'He was' y 'They were', y practiquen ambas.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the word that completes the sentence: Grandpa ate ___ orange after lunch.
items.explain: 'Orange' begins with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'.

concept.es: elegir entre a y an

tip.en: Look around the house and say 'a' or 'an' before each object; an goes before vowel sounds.
tip.es: Miren alrededor de la casa y digan 'a' o 'an' antes de cada objeto; 'an' va antes de sonidos de vocal.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Identify a noun in a sentence
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a noun? 'We walked quickly to the old bridge.'
items.explain: 'Bridge' names a thing, so it is a noun.

concept.es: identificar sustantivos en las oraciones

tip.en: Hunt for naming words, people, places and things, in a page of a book and underline them.
tip.es: Busquen en una página de un libro las palabras que nombran personas, lugares y cosas, y subráyenlas.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a proper noun? 'My best friend Lucy lives near the river.'
items.explain: 'Lucy' names a specific person, so it is a proper noun.

concept.es: reconocer nombres propios

tip.en: Write names of people, towns and holidays and notice they begin with capital letters.
tip.es: Escriban nombres de personas, pueblos y fiestas y noten que empiezan con letra mayúscula.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is an action word (verb)? 'The little puppy jumped over the fence.'
items.explain: 'Jumped' tells what the puppy did.

concept.es: identificar verbos de acción

tip.en: Play charades with action words like jump and swim, then find the action word in a sentence.
tip.es: Jueguen a las mímicas con verbos como jump y swim, y luego busquen el verbo en una oración.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Read: 'Hannah was glad when her grandmother came to visit. She hugged her and smiled all day.' Which word means almost the same as 'glad'?
items.explain: 'Glad' and 'happy' are synonyms; the hugging and smiling show it.

concept.es: encontrar palabras con significado parecido

tip.en: Play a word-twin game: say a word like 'big' and take turns naming words that mean almost the same.
tip.es: Jueguen a las palabras gemelas: digan una palabra como 'big' y túrnense para nombrar otras de significado parecido.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: ___ your sister like to read?
items.explain: 'Sister' is singular, so the question begins with 'Does'.

concept.es: elegir entre do y does

tip.en: Practice questions aloud: 'Do you...' and 'Does she...', noticing that does goes with one person.
tip.es: Practiquen preguntas en voz alta: 'Do you...' y 'Does she...', notando que 'does' va con una sola persona.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: Last night the wind ___ the leaves off the tree.
items.explain: 'Blew' is the past tense of blow; 'blue' is a color.

concept.es: elegir la palabra correcta entre homófonos

tip.en: Make picture cards for pairs like blew and blue, and use each in a sentence you say aloud.
tip.es: Hagan tarjetas con dibujos de pares como blew y blue y usen cada una en una oración dicha en voz alta.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence is written correctly?
options: The dogs bone is under the porch.
The dog's bone is under the porch.
The dogs' bone are under the porch.
The dog bone's is under the porch.
items.explain: One dog owns the bone, so we write dog's, and 'bone is' agrees.

concept.en: using an apostrophe to show ownership
concept.es: usar el apóstrofo para indicar posesión

tip.en: Label belongings like 'Mom's cup' and 'Dad's hat' with sticky notes to see the apostrophe at work.
tip.es: Etiqueten objetos como 'Mom's cup' y 'Dad's hat' con notas adhesivas para ver el apóstrofo en acción.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which list of words is in alphabetical order?
items.explain: a, b, c, d is alphabetical: ant, bell, cup, dog.

concept.es: ordenar palabras alfabéticamente

tip.en: Write family or pet names on cards and arrange them in ABC order by first letter.
tip.es: Escriban nombres de familiares o mascotas en tarjetas y ordénenlas según su primera letra.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word comes FIRST in alphabetical order?
items.explain: All begin with br; the third letters are e, i, a, o, and a comes first. (Cursive handwriting cannot be assessed in text, so alphabetizing is measured instead.)

concept.es: ordenar alfabéticamente hasta la tercera letra

tip.en: Practice with words sharing first letters, like 'cap', 'car' and 'cat', and compare letter by letter.
tip.es: Practiquen con palabras que comparten las primeras letras, como 'cap', 'car' y 'cat', comparando letra por letra.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which group of words is a complete sentence?
items.explain: 'Joel shared his lunch.' has a subject and a verb and a complete thought.

concept.es: distinguir oraciones completas de fragmentos

tip.en: Ask 'Who or what? What did they do?' for each group of words to check it is complete.
tip.es: Pregunten '¿Quién o qué? ¿Qué hizo?' en cada grupo de palabras para comprobar que está completo.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What is the subject of this sentence? 'Every morning, the farmer feeds his cows.'
items.explain: The farmer is the one who does the action (feeds).

concept.en: finding the subject of a sentence
concept.es: encontrar el sujeto de una oración

tip.en: Ask 'Who or what is this sentence about?' with sentences from a favorite book, then underline the answer.
tip.es: Pregunten '¿De quién o de qué trata la oración?' con frases de un libro favorito y subrayen la respuesta.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which pronoun can take the place of 'Maria and I' in this sentence? 'Maria and I sang a song at church.'
items.explain: 'Maria and I' is a subject that includes the speaker, so 'We' is correct.

concept.en: using subject pronouns like we and they
concept.es: usar pronombres como we y they

tip.en: Replace names in sentences with pronouns, such as 'Maria and I' becoming 'we', and read them aloud.
tip.es: Cambien nombres por pronombres en oraciones, como 'Maria and I' por 'we', y léanlas en voz alta.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is a being (state-of-being) verb? 'The kittens were sleepy after their meal.'
items.explain: 'Were' is a form of 'be'; it links the kittens to 'sleepy'.

concept.es: reconocer los verbos de estado (to be)

tip.en: Make a poster of being verbs (am, is, are, was, were) and spot them in a short story.
tip.es: Hagan un cartel con los verbos am, is, are, was, were y búsquenlos en un cuento corto.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is spelled correctly?
items.explain: The correct spelling is b-e-c-a-u-s-e. (Cursive capitals cannot be assessed in text, so spelling is measured instead.)

concept.es: escribir correctamente palabras comunes

tip.en: Practice a few everyday words each week with look, say, cover, write and check.
tip.es: Practiquen unas pocas palabras comunes cada semana: mirar, decir, tapar, escribir y comprobar.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Find an antonym in a passage
items.prompt: Read: 'At first, the path up the hill was smooth. Near the top, it became rough and full of rocks.' Which word in the passage is an antonym of 'smooth'?
items.explain: 'Rough' means the opposite of 'smooth'.

concept.en: finding opposite words in a passage
concept.es: encontrar palabras opuestas en un texto

tip.en: Play an opposites game with words like hot and cold, then hunt for opposites in a short paragraph.
tip.es: Jueguen a los opuestos con palabras como hot y cold y luego búsquenlos en un párrafo corto.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: We could not ___ the music because the room was so noisy.
items.explain: 'Hear' means to listen with your ears; 'here' is a place.

concept.es: elegir la palabra correcta entre homófonos

tip.en: Keep a list of pairs like hear and here and write a funny sentence for each one.
tip.es: Hagan una lista de pares como hear y here y escriban una oración divertida para cada uno.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
options: On thanksgiving day, we visited aunt Ruth.
On Thanksgiving day, We visited Aunt ruth.
On Thanksgiving Day, we visited Aunt Ruth.
on Thanksgiving Day, we visited aunt ruth.
items.explain: Holidays, titles used with names, names, and the first word of a sentence are capitalized.

concept.es: usar mayúsculas correctamente

tip.en: Write about your family trip and check that names, holidays and titles start with capitals.
tip.es: Escriban sobre un paseo familiar y revisen que nombres, fiestas y títulos empiecen con mayúscula.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: The robin built ___ nest in the maple tree.
items.explain: 'Its' shows ownership; 'it's' means 'it is'.

concept.es: elegir entre its e it's

tip.en: Remember that it's means 'it is'; try reading the sentence with 'it is' to check.
tip.es: Recuerden que it's significa 'it is'; lean la oración con 'it is' para comprobar cuál corresponde.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What is the contraction for 'they will'?
items.explain: The apostrophe replaces 'wi' in 'will': they'll.

concept.es: formar contracciones

tip.en: Make word cards like 'they will' and 'they'll' and match them, noticing the apostrophe replaces letters.
tip.es: Hagan tarjetas como 'they will' y 'they'll' y empárejenlas, notando que el apóstrofo reemplaza letras.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: An envelope has a name and address in the upper left corner: 'Ruth Allen, 12 Pine Street, Ocala, FL'. In the center it has: 'Mr. David Cole, 45 Lake Road, Tampa, FL'. Who will receive this letter?
items.explain: The address in the center belongs to the receiver; the upper left is the sender's return address.

concept.es: leer los datos de un sobre

tip.en: Write and address a real letter to a grandparent, placing sender and receiver in the right spots.
tip.es: Escriban y dirijan una carta real a un abuelo, colocando remitente y destinatario en su lugar.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word would come LAST in alphabetical order?
items.explain: Order is shadow, shell, shelter, shepherd; 'shep' comes after 'shel'.

concept.es: ordenar alfabéticamente más allá de la tercera letra

tip.en: Alphabetize longer words like 'plant', 'plane' and 'plank' by comparing each letter in turn.
tip.es: Ordenen palabras largas como 'plant', 'plane' y 'plank' comparando cada letra por turno.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Classify sentence types in a passage
items.prompt: Read: 'Mia helped her neighbor plant tomatoes. "Will they grow by summer?" she asked. Mr. Ortiz smiled. "Water them every day!"' Which sentence from the passage is interrogative?
options: Mia helped her neighbor plant tomatoes.
items.explain: An interrogative sentence asks a question and ends with a question mark.

concept.es: reconocer los tipos de oraciones

tip.en: Read dialogue aloud and label sentences as telling, asking or exclaiming by how they sound.
tip.es: Lean un diálogo en voz alta y clasifiquen las oraciones como enunciativas, preguntas o exclamaciones según su sonido.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word in this sentence is a plural common noun? 'On Friday, Pastor Lee read a story to the children at Grace Church.'
items.explain: 'Children' is plural and not a specific name; the others are proper nouns.

concept.es: identificar sustantivos en plural

tip.en: Find nouns naming more than one thing in a page of reading and circle them.
tip.es: Busquen en una página de lectura los sustantivos que nombran más de una cosa y rodéenlos.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: What are the simple subject and the verb in this sentence? 'The busy bees in the garden make sweet honey.'
items.explain: 'Bees' is who does the action and 'make' is the verb; 'garden' is inside a prepositional phrase.

concept.es: encontrar el sujeto y el verbo

tip.en: Cover the extra words in a sentence until only the who and the action remain.
tip.es: Tapen las palabras extra de una oración hasta que queden solo el quién y la acción.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: Mom gave the tickets to Isaac and ___.
items.explain: After the preposition 'to', use the object pronoun 'me'.

concept.en: choosing the right pronoun after a verb
concept.es: elegir el pronombre correcto tras el verbo

tip.en: Try the sentence with only one person, such as 'gave it to me', to pick me or I.
tip.es: Prueben la oración con una sola persona, como 'gave it to me', para elegir entre me e I.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which word is an adverb? 'The choir sang softly during the evening service.'
items.explain: 'Softly' tells how the choir sang, so it is an adverb.

concept.es: reconocer los adverbios

tip.en: Act out verbs in different ways, like walking slowly or quickly, and name the word that tells how.
tip.es: Representen verbos de distintas formas, como caminar slowly o quickly, y nombren la palabra que dice cómo.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence uses an apostrophe correctly?
options: My brother's bike has a flat tire.
items.explain: 'Brother's' correctly shows that the bike belongs to the brother.

concept.es: usar bien los apóstrofos

tip.en: Sort examples into contractions and ownership words, and explain why each apostrophe is there.
tip.es: Clasifiquen ejemplos en contracciones y palabras de posesión, explicando por qué lleva apóstrofo cada una.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
items.explain: The spoken words are in quotation marks with a comma inside, and the sentence ends with a period.

concept.es: puntuar los diálogos

tip.en: Write a short conversation between two family members, using quotation marks around the exact spoken words.
tip.es: Escriban una conversación corta entre dos familiares, con comillas alrededor de las palabras exactas que se dicen.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: We walked ___ the gate into the garden.
items.explain: 'Through' means from one side to the other; 'threw' is the past of throw.

concept.es: elegir la palabra correcta entre homófonos

tip.en: Practice pairs like through and threw by writing a short story that uses each one.
tip.es: Practiquen pares como through y threw escribiendo un cuento corto que use cada uno.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct word: After the long hike, Dad wanted to ___ down on the couch.
items.explain: 'Lie' means to rest and takes no object; 'lay' needs an object.

concept.es: elegir entre lie y lay

tip.en: Remember that lie means to rest yourself; say 'I lie down' and try a few sentences.
tip.es: Recuerden que lie significa descansar uno mismo; digan 'I lie down' y prueben varias oraciones.

items.subject: ela
items.prompt: Choose the correct verb: By the time we arrived, the bell had already ___.
items.explain: After 'had', use the past participle of ring: rung.

concept.es: usar el participio pasado de los verbos

tip.en: Practice 'have/had' plus a verb, like 'had rung' and 'had eaten', with a list of common irregular verbs.
tip.es: Practiquen 'have/had' más un verbo, como 'had rung' y 'had eaten', con una lista de verbos irregulares comunes.

items.subject: ela
items.skill: Identify parts of a business letter
items.prompt: In a business letter, which part comes right before the writer's signature?
items.explain: The closing comes just before the signature; the heading, inside address and greeting come at the top.

concept.es: partes de una carta formal

tip.en: Write a thank-you letter to your church or a friend, labeling the greeting, body, closing and signature.
tip.es: Escriban una carta de agradecimiento a su iglesia o a un amigo, marcando saludo, cuerpo, despedida y firma.
